notes: Redevelopment Agency minutes 1974-81 (thirteen volumes). Curated onto pages that exist: Victorian Square's rehabilitation, the Kimochi and JCCCNC sites in Nihonmachi, the Goodman Building, Opera Plaza's last demolition.

coverage.remaining: Not placed (no page, or the building is gone): the Emanuel Church of God in Christ murals at 1540 Post (demolished 1974); the Royal Adah Arms, 1390 Turk Street, dedicated June 9, 1974; the Imperial Hotel, 140 Fourth Street (demolition 1976); the Manor Plaza Hotel; the Mercantile, Williams and Blumenthal buildings and the Jessie Street Hotel in Yerba Buena Center; Victorian moves to Beideman Place (1759 Sutter to 1980 Ellis, Nov 1978); 939 Eddy's rehabilitation for the Housing Authority; 1724 and 1750 Fillmore; the Malcolm X Cultural Center building at 685-91 McAllister; Opera Plaza's design (John Carl Warnecke and Associates, June 1979). Private buyers of rehabilitated houses are not named.
